items.title: Daryl Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2024
items.q: And I did an Artie Shaw program with them, that’s how we got to know each other.

ctx.x: Who was very busy in the studios. Yeah. Yeah. He’s going to be going to London, we’re going to do the Blossom/Frishberg show again. And he sings. So that adds another entertainment dimension. And now I have a twin act. Peter and Will Anderson, or Will and Peter Anderson went through the Juilliard School program. I met them because one of my friends was the director of a theater, 59 — East 59th . He discovered them busking in Central Park and hired them to play one night a week at the bar of the theater. And from…

because they’re exceptional musicians, but I think they just have this twinny thing. They must. It is extraordinary, and the way they play together. And it sounds like I’m singing with an orchestra. And they’re cute. They’re so — they’re actually over 30 now, and they’re both fathers of now two children.
